ActiveFlowLog.title: Activate a flow log
ActiveFlowLog.summary: Activates a flow log to start capturing traffic of specified resources.

AddTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolic.title: Add traffic classification rules to a traffic marking policy
AddTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolic.summary: Adds traffic classification rules to a traffic marking policy by calling the AddTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy operation.

AddTraficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy.title: AddTraficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy
AddTraficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy.summary: Adds a traffic classification rule to a traffic marking policy.

AssociateCenBandwidthPackage.title: Associate a bandwidth package with a specified CEN instance
AssociateCenBandwidthPackage.summary: Associates a bandwidth package instance with a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.title: Associate a vSwitch in a VPC with a multicast domain
AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.summary: Associates a vSwitch in a virtual private cloud (VPC) with a multicast domain by calling the AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain operation so that resources in the VPC can communicate through multicast.

AttachCenChildInstance.title: Attach a network instance to a CEN instance
AttachCenChildInstance.summary: Attaches a network instance to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

CheckTransitRouterService.title: CheckTransitRouterService
CheckTransitRouterService.summary: Queries whether your Alibaba Cloud account has the transit router feature activated.

CreateCen.title: Create a CEN instance
CreateCen.summary: A Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance is the fundamental resource for managing an integrated network. A CEN instance manages one network and can span one or more regions. Before enabling connectivity between network instances, call the CreateCen operation to create a CEN instance.

CreateCenBandwidthPackage.title: Create a bandwidth plan
CreateCenBandwidthPackage.summary: Creates a bandwidth plan for Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) to enable cross-region connectivity between network instances.

CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.title: Add a route entry to a network instance connected to an enterprise edition transit router
CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.summary: Adds a route entry to a network instance connected to an Enterprise Edition transit router. The destination CIDR block points to the transit router in the current region as the next hop.

CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.title: Add a route entry to a network instance
CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.summary: Adds a route entry to a network instance by calling the CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen operation.

CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.title: Create a cross-region traffic scheduling policy
CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.summary: Creates a cross-region traffic scheduling policy for an Enterprise Edition transit router to optimize and control network traffic across regions.

CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.title: Create a queue configuration under a traffic scheduling policy
CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.summary: Creates a queue configuration under a traffic scheduling policy. If you need to manage different types and priorities of network traffic to ensure the performance of critical service traffic and comply with Service-Level Agreements (SLAs), you can call the CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue operation.

CreateCenRouteMap.title: Create a routing policy
CreateCenRouteMap.summary: Creates a routing policy. The routing policy feature allows you to filter route information and customize the management of cloud network connectivity.

CreateTrafficMarkingPolicy.title: Create a traffic marking policy
CreateTrafficMarkingPolicy.summary: A traffic marking policy captures traffic that matches traffic classification rules and adds a Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value to the traffic as a mark. Creates a traffic marking policy by calling CreateTrafficMarkingPolicy.

CreateTransitRouter.title: Create an enterprise edition transit router instance
CreateTransitRouter.summary: Calls the CreateTransitRouter operation to create an Enterprise Edition transit router instance.

CreateTransitRouterCidr.title: Create a CIDR block for a transit router
CreateTransitRouterCidr.summary: A transit router CIDR block is a custom CIDR block that you define for a transit router, similar to a CIDR block from which IP addresses are assigned to a router loopback interface. Calls the CreateTransitRouterCidr operation to create a CIDR block for a transit router.

CreateTransitRouterEcrAttachment.title: Create an ECR connection on an Enterprise Edition transit router
CreateTransitRouterEcrAttachment.summary: Creates a connection between an Express Connect Router (ECR) instance and a transit router instance in the same region.

CreateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.title: Create a multicast domain
CreateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.summary: Creates a multicast domain. A multicast domain defines the scope of a multicast network within a region. Only resources within the multicast domain can send and receive multicast traffic. Resources outside the multicast domain cannot send or receive multicast traffic.

CreateTransitRouterPeerAttachment.title: Create an inter-region connection for an enterprise edition transit router
CreateTransitRouterPeerAttachment.summary: After network instances (VPCs, VBRs, and IPsec connections) are connected to a transit router, you must create an inter-region connection between transit routers to enable communication between network instances in different regions. You can call the CreateTransitRouterPeerAttachment operation to create an inter-region connection for an Enterprise Edition transit router instance.

CreateTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.title: Associate a prefix list with an enterprise edition transit router route table
CreateTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.summary: Associates a prefix list with an Enterprise Edition transit router route table.

CreateTransitRouterRouteEntry.title: Add a route entry to an enterprise edition transit router route table
CreateTransitRouterRouteEntry.summary: Adds a route entry to a route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router.

CreateTransitRouterRouteTable.title: Create a custom route table for an enterprise edition transit router
CreateTransitRouterRouteTable.summary: Creates a custom route table for an Enterprise Edition transit router by calling the CreateTransitRouterRouteTable operation.

CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment.title: Create a VBR connection on an enterprise edition transit router
CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment.summary: Invokes the CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment operation to connect a Virtual Border Router (VBR) network instance to a transit router instance in the same region. After the connection is established, the transit router can help you achieve private network peering.

CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment.title: Create a VPC connection on an enterprise edition transit router
CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment.summary: Calls the CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment operation to connect a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) instance to a transit router instance for private network peering. After the connection is established, the transit router instance can help you achieve private network peering.

CreateTransitRouterVpnAttachment.title: Create a VPN connection
CreateTransitRouterVpnAttachment.summary: Transit routers support connections to IPsec connections of VPN gateways. An on-premises data center can directly connect to a transit router through an IPsec connection, and then communicate with other networks through the transit router. Calls the CreateTransitRouterVpnAttachment operation to create a VPN connection.

DeactiveFlowLog.title: Deactivate a flow log
DeactiveFlowLog.summary: Deactivates a flow log. After the flow log is deactivated, traffic of the specified resource is no longer captured.

DeleteCen.title: Delete a specified CEN instance
DeleteCen.summary: Deletes a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.title: Delete a route entry from a network instance connected to an enterprise edition transit router
DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.summary: Deletes a route entry from a network instance connected to an Enterprise Edition transit router.

DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.title: Delete a route entry from a network instance
DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.summary: Deletes a route entry from a network instance.

DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.title: Delete a traffic scheduling policy
DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.summary: Deletes a traffic scheduling policy by calling the DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy operation.

DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.title: DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue
DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.summary: Deletes a queue from a quality of service (QoS) policy.

DeleteCenRouteMap.title: DeleteCenRouteMap
DeleteCenRouteMap.summary: The DeleteCenRouteMap operation deletes a specified routing policy.

DeleteRouteServiceInCen.title: DeleteRouteServiceInCen
DeleteRouteServiceInCen.summary: Call the DeleteRouteServiceInCen operation to delete the configuration of an Alibaba Cloud service from a Basic Edition transit router.

DeleteTrafficMarkingPolicy.title: Delete a traffic marking policy
DeleteTrafficMarkingPolicy.summary: Calls the DeleteTrafficMarkingPolicy operation to delete a traffic marking policy.

DeleteTransitRouter.title: Delete a transit router instance
DeleteTransitRouter.summary: Calls the DeleteTransitRouter operation to delete an Enterprise Edition transit router instance.

DeleteTransitRouterCidr.title: Delete a CIDR block from a transit router
DeleteTransitRouterCidr.summary: Deletes a CIDR block from a transit router.

DeleteTransitRouterEcrAttachment.title: DeleteTransitRouterEcrAttachment
DeleteTransitRouterEcrAttachment.summary: Deletes an Express Connect Router (ECR) connection from an Enterprise Edition transit router.

DeleteTransitRouterMulticastDomain.title: DeleteTransitRouterMulticastDomain
DeleteTransitRouterMulticastDomain.summary: You can call the DeleteTransitRouterMulticastDomain operation to delete a multicast domain.

DeleteTransitRouterPeerAttachment.title: Delete an inter-region connection from an enterprise edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterPeerAttachment.summary: Calls the DeleteTransitRouterPeerAttachment operation to delete an inter-region connection from an Enterprise Edition transit router.

DeleteTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.title: DeleteTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation
DeleteTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.summary: Disassociates the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router from a prefix list.

DeleteTransitRouterRouteEntry.title: Delete static route entries from an Enterprise Edition transit router route table
DeleteTransitRouterRouteEntry.summary: Calls the DeleteTransitRouterRouteEntry operation to delete static route entries of the blackhole or connection instance type from an Enterprise Edition transit router route table.

DeleteTransitRouterRouteTable.title: Delete a custom route table from an enterprise edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterRouteTable.summary: Deletes a custom route table from an Enterprise Edition transit router.

DeleteTransitRouterVbrAttachment.title: Delete a VBR connection from an enterprise edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterVbrAttachment.summary: Deletes a virtual border router (VBR) connection from an Enterprise Edition transit router.

DeleteTransitRouterVpcAttachment.title: DeleteTransitRouterVpcAttachment
DeleteTransitRouterVpcAttachment.summary: Deletes a virtual private cloud (VPC) connection from an Enterprise Edition transit router.

DeleteTransitRouterVpnAttachment.title: Delete a VPN connection
DeleteTransitRouterVpnAttachment.summary: Deletes a VPN connection by calling the DeleteTransitRouterVpnAttachment operation.

DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMem.title: Remove multicast members
DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMem.summary: Removes a multicast member from a multicast group if the member no longer needs to receive multicast traffic by calling the DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembers operation.

DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSou.title: Delete multicast sources
DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSou.summary: Removes a multicast source from a multicast group if you no longer need the multicast source to send multicast traffic.

DescribeCenAttachedChildInstanceAttribut.title: Query details of a network instance (VPC, VBR, or CCN)
DescribeCenAttachedChildInstanceAttribut.summary: Queries the details of a network instance (VPC, VBR, or CCN) attached to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, including the attachment status and network instance type.

DescribeCenAttachedChildInstances.title: Query network instances attached to a CEN instance
DescribeCenAttachedChildInstances.summary: Queries information about network instances attached to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

DescribeCenBandwidthPackages.title: Query details of all bandwidth packages under an account
DescribeCenBandwidthPackages.summary: Queries information about bandwidth package instances.

DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries.title: DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries
DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries.summary: Queries the routes of a network instance that is attached to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

DescribeCenGeographicSpanRemainingBandwi.title: DescribeCenGeographicSpanRemainingBandwidth
DescribeCenGeographicSpanRemainingBandwi.summary: Queries the remaining bandwidth of a specified bandwidth plan.

DescribeCenGeographicSpans.title: DescribeCenGeographicSpans
DescribeCenGeographicSpans.summary: You can call the DescribeCenGeographicSpans operation to query the connected areas supported by Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN).

DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits.title: Query inter-region bandwidth between regions
DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits.summary: Queries the inter-region bandwidth information between regions by calling the DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits operation.

DescribeCenPrivateZoneRoutes.title: DescribeCenPrivateZoneRoutes
DescribeCenPrivateZoneRoutes.summary: Queries the PrivateZone service configurations of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

DescribeCenRegionDomainRouteEntries.title: Query route entry details of an instance
DescribeCenRegionDomainRouteEntries.summary: Queries the details of route entries in a specific region of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

DescribeCenRouteMaps.title: DescribeCenRouteMaps
DescribeCenRouteMaps.summary: You can call the DescribeCenRouteMaps operation to query the configurations of routing policies.

DescribeCenVbrHealthCheck.title: DescribeCenVbrHealthCheck
DescribeCenVbrHealthCheck.summary: Queries the health check information for a virtual border router (VBR) in a specified region.

DescribeCens.title: Query all CEN instances under an account
DescribeCens.summary: Queries information about Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instances under the current Alibaba Cloud account, including the instance status, whether IPv6 is enabled, and the list of bandwidth packages associated with the instances.

DescribeChildInstanceRegions.title: DescribeChildInstanceRegions
DescribeChildInstanceRegions.summary: You can call the DescribeChildInstanceRegions operation to query the regions where you can attach network instances to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

DescribeGeographicRegionMembership.title: Query all regions within a specified area
DescribeGeographicRegionMembership.summary: Queries region information within a specified area.

DescribeGrantRulesToCen.title: View authorization relationships between network instances and a CEN instance
DescribeGrantRulesToCen.summary: Queries information about cross-account network instances that are authorized to be associated with a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

DescribeGrantRulesToResource.title: Query authorization information of a network instance for a cross-account CEN instance
DescribeGrantRulesToResource.summary: Queries the authorization information of a network instance for a cross-account Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, including the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the CEN instance and the payer of the network instance.

DescribePublishedRouteEntries.title: DescribePublishedRouteEntries
DescribePublishedRouteEntries.summary: Queries whether the routes of virtual private clouds (VPCs) and virtual border routers (VBRs) are advertised to the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance to which the VCPs and VBRs are attached, the instance type of the next hop of each route, and whether advertised routes can be withdrawn.

DescribeRouteConflict.title: DescribeRouteConflict
DescribeRouteConflict.summary: The DescribeRouteConflict operation queries conflicting routes in a network instance.

DescribeRouteServicesInCen.title: Query cloud service configurations
DescribeRouteServicesInCen.summary: Queries the cloud service configurations under a Basic Edition transit router by calling the DescribeRouteServicesInCen operation.

DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregation.title: DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregation
DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregation.summary: Queries the aggregate routes in the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router.

DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregationDeta.title: DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregationDetail
DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregationDeta.summary: Queries the configuration details of a specified aggregate route.

DetachCenChildInstance.title: Detach a network instance from a CEN instance
DetachCenChildInstance.summary: Detaches a network instance from a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

DisableCenVbrHealthCheck.title: Disable health check for a VBR
DisableCenVbrHealthCheck.summary: Disables health checks for a specified virtual border router (VBR).

DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.title: Disassociate a vSwitch from a multicast domain
DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.summary: Disassociates a vSwitch from a multicast domain.

DissociateTransitRouterAttachmentFromRou.title: Dissociate a forwarding association
DissociateTransitRouterAttachmentFromRou.summary: Dissociates a network instance connection from a route table.

EnableCenVbrHealthCheck.title: Enable health check for a virtual border router (VBR)
EnableCenVbrHealthCheck.summary: Enables or modifies the health check configuration for a virtual border router (VBR) to ensure timely detection of faulty Express Connect circuits.

GrantInstanceToTransitRouter.title: Grant a transit router instance permissions to connect to a cross-account network instance
GrantInstanceToTransitRouter.summary: Grants permissions to a transit router instance to connect to a network instance that belongs to a different account. Before a transit router instance can connect to a network instance that belongs to a different account, the network instance must authorize the transit router instance. Call the GrantInstanceToTransitRouter operation to grant the authorization.

ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttach.title: ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttachment
ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttach.summary: Queries the routes that point to a network instance connection. The routes are retrieved from the route table of a network instance that is attached to an Enterprise Edition transit router.

ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies.title: ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies
ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies.summary: You can call the ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies operation to query Quality of Service (QoS) policies.

ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues.title: ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues
ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues.summary: Queries the queues of a Quality of Service (QoS) policy.

ListGrantVSwitchEnis.title: Query ENIs that can serve as multicast sources or members in a VPC
ListGrantVSwitchEnis.summary: Queries the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) within a virtual private cloud (VPC) that can serve as multicast sources or multicast members for multicast communication.

ListGrantVSwitchesToCen.title: ListGrantVSwitchesToCen
ListGrantVSwitchesToCen.summary: You can call the ListGrantVSwitchesToCen operation to query vSwitches in a cross-account VPC that is connected to a CEN instance.

ListTagResources.title: Query tags bound to a CEN instance
ListTagResources.summary: Queries the tags bound to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

ListTrafficMarkingPolicies.title: ListTrafficMarkingPolicies
ListTrafficMarkingPolicies.summary: You can call the ListTrafficMarkingPolicies operation to query details about traffic marking policies, such as their status and priority.

ListTransitRouterAvailableResource.title: ListTransitRouterAvailableResource
ListTransitRouterAvailableResource.summary: Queries the zones that are available for an Enterprise Edition transit router in a specified region.

ListTransitRouterCidr.title: ListTransitRouterCidr
ListTransitRouterCidr.summary: Queries the CIDR blocks of a transit router.

ListTransitRouterCidrAllocation.title: ListTransitRouterCidrAllocation
ListTransitRouterCidrAllocation.summary: Queries the allocation details of a CIDR block.

ListTransitRouterEcrAttachments.title: ListTransitRouterEcrAttachments
ListTransitRouterEcrAttachments.summary: Queries the information about Express Connect Router (ECR) connections on an Enterprise Edition transit router, such as the connection status, connection ID, and the payer of instance fees.

ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainAssociat.title: Query multicast domain associations
ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainAssociat.summary: Queries the associations between a multicast domain and vSwitches.

ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitche.title: ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitches
ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitche.summary: After a VPC instance is connected to an Enterprise Edition transit router, you can call the ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitches operation to query information about vSwitches that are attached to multicast domains in the virtual private cloud (VPC) instance.

ListTransitRouterMulticastDomains.title: Query multicast domain information
ListTransitRouterMulticastDomains.summary: Queries information about multicast domains, such as the status, multicast domain ID, and description of multicast domains.

ListTransitRouterMulticastGroups.title: ListTransitRouterMulticastGroups
ListTransitRouterMulticastGroups.summary: Queries details about multicast members and sources in a multicast domain.

ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments.title: ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments
ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments.summary: Call the ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments operation to query details about the inter-region connections of an Enterprise Edition transit router.

ListTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.title: ListTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation
ListTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.summary: Queries the prefix list associations for the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router.

ListTransitRouterRouteEntries.title: ListTransitRouterRouteEntries
ListTransitRouterRouteEntries.summary: Queries the details about routes in the route tables of an Enterprise Edition transit router.

ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations.title: ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations
ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations.summary: Call the ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations operation to query the forwarding associations for a route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router or for a network instance connection.

ListTransitRouterRouteTablePropagations.title: ListTransitRouterRouteTablePropagations
ListTransitRouterRouteTablePropagations.summary: Lists the route propagations for the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router.

ListTransitRouterRouteTables.title: ListTransitRouterRouteTables
ListTransitRouterRouteTables.summary: Call the ListTransitRouterRouteTables operation to query the route tables associated with an Enterprise Edition transit router.

ListTransitRouterVbrAttachments.title: Query VBR connections under an enterprise edition transit router
ListTransitRouterVbrAttachments.summary: Queries the connection information of virtual border routers (VBRs) under an Enterprise Edition transit router, including the total number of entries, connection status, connection IDs, and payers of network instances.

ListTransitRouterVpcAttachments.title: ListTransitRouterVpcAttachments
ListTransitRouterVpcAttachments.summary: Queries details about virtual private cloud (VPC) connections on an Enterprise Edition transit router, including the connection status, billing method, and zone, as well as the vSwitches and elastic network interfaces (ENIs) of the connected VPC.

ListTransitRouterVpnAttachments.title: Query VPN connection information
ListTransitRouterVpnAttachments.summary: Queries information about VPN connections, such as the status, IPsec connection ID, and billing method of VPN connections.

ListTransitRouters.title: Query transit router instances under a CEN instance
ListTransitRouters.summary: Queries information about transit router instances under a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, including the instance type, instance status, transit router instance ID, and whether the multicast feature is enabled.

ModifyCenAttribute.title: Modify the name and description of a CEN instance
ModifyCenAttribute.summary: Modifies the name and description of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

ModifyCenBandwidthPackageAttribute.title: Modify the name and description of a bandwidth plan instance
ModifyCenBandwidthPackageAttribute.summary: Modifies the name and description of a bandwidth plan instance.

ModifyCenBandwidthPackageSpec.title: Modify the peak bandwidth of a bandwidth plan instance
ModifyCenBandwidthPackageSpec.summary: Modifies the peak bandwidth of a bandwidth plan instance by calling the ModifyCenBandwidthPackageSpec operation.

ModifyCenRouteMap.title: Modify a routing policy
ModifyCenRouteMap.summary: Modifies a routing policy by calling the ModifyCenRouteMap operation.

ModifyFlowLogAttribute.title: Modify flow log attributes
ModifyFlowLogAttribute.summary: Modifies the name, description, and capture window duration of a flow log.

ModifyGrantInstanceToTransitRouter.title: Modify a cross-account authorization record
ModifyGrantInstanceToTransitRouter.summary: Modifies the payer for a cross-account network instance connection of a transit router instance.

ModifyTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPo.title: ModifyTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy
ModifyTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPo.summary: Modifies the name and description of a stream classification rule.

ModifyTransitRouterCidr.title: Modify a CIDR block of a transit router
ModifyTransitRouterCidr.summary: Calls the ModifyTransitRouterCidr operation to modify a CIDR block of a transit router.

ModifyTransitRouterMulticastDomain.title: Modify multicast domain configuration
ModifyTransitRouterMulticastDomain.summary: Modifies the name, description, and feature options of a multicast domain.

MoveResourceGroup.title: MoveResourceGroup
MoveResourceGroup.summary: You can call the MoveResourceGroup operation to move a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance or a bandwidth plan to a different resource group.

PublishRouteEntries.title: Publish a route entry to CEN
PublishRouteEntries.summary: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) supports the publish route entry feature. You can publish routing entries from a VPC or VBR that is loaded into CEN to CEN by calling the PublishRouteEntries operation. If no route conflict exists, other network instances in CEN can learn the published routes.

RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembe.title: Create multicast members
RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembe.summary: Calls the RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembers operation to create or add multicast members.

RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSourc.title: Create multicast sources
RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSourc.summary: Creates multicast sources to implement one-to-many multicast communication.

RemoveTrafficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarking.title: Remove traffic classification rules from a traffic marking policy
RemoveTrafficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarking.summary: Removes traffic classification rules from a traffic marking policy by calling the RemoveTrafficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarkingPolicy operation.

RemoveTraficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarkingP.title: RemoveTraficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarkingPolicy
RemoveTraficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarkingP.summary: Removes a traffic classification rule from a traffic marking policy.

ReplaceTransitRouterRouteTableAssociatio.title: ReplaceTransitRouterRouteTableAssociation
ReplaceTransitRouterRouteTableAssociatio.summary: Replaces the route table that is associated with a network instance connection.

ResolveAndRouteServiceInCen.title: Set up cloud service access
ResolveAndRouteServiceInCen.summary: Configures cloud services to add access configurations for on-premises networks to access cloud services through Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN).

RevokeInstanceFromTransitRouter.title: Revoke the permission for a transit router to connect to a cross-account network instance
RevokeInstanceFromTransitRouter.summary: Revokes the permission that allows a transit router to connect to a cross-account network instance.

RoutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc.title: RoutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc
RoutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc.summary: Call the RoutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc operation to configure the PrivateZone service.

SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit.title: SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit
SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit.summary: You can call the SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit operation to set, modify, or delete the inter-region bandwidth between two regions in a bandwidth plan for a Basic Edition transit router.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: Creates and attaches tags to resources.

TempUpgradeCenBandwidthPackageSpec.title: TempUpgradeCenBandwidthPackageSpec
TempUpgradeCenBandwidthPackageSpec.summary: Temporarily upgrades a subscription bandwidth plan of Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN).

UnassociateCenBandwidthPackage.title: Disassociate a bandwidth package from a CEN instance
UnassociateCenBandwidthPackage.summary: Disassociates a bandwidth package from a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance. After the disassociation, the bandwidth package can be associated with another CEN instance.

UnroutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc.title: Delete privateZone
UnroutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc.summary: Deletes the PrivateZone service configuration by calling the UnroutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc operation.

UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicyAttr.title: UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicyAttribute
UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicyAttr.summary: Modifies the name and description of a quality of service (QoS) policy.

UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttri.title: UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttribute
UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttri.summary: Modifies the name, description, inter-region bandwidth, and Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value of a quality of service (QoS) queue.

UpdateTrafficMarkingPolicyAttribute.title: Modify the name, description, and traffic classification rules of a traffic marking policy
UpdateTrafficMarkingPolicyAttribute.summary: Modifies the name, description, and traffic classification rules of a traffic marking policy.

UpdateTransitRouter.title: Modify transit router instance information
UpdateTransitRouter.summary: Modifies the name and description of a transit router instance.

UpdateTransitRouterEcrAttachmentAttribut.title: UpdateTransitRouterEcrAttachmentAttribute
UpdateTransitRouterEcrAttachmentAttribut.summary: Modifies the name and description of an ECR attachment for an Enterprise Edition Transit Router.

UpdateTransitRouterPeerAttachmentAttribu.title: Modify the configuration of an inter-region connection on an enterprise edition transit router
UpdateTransitRouterPeerAttachmentAttribu.summary: Modifies the configuration of an inter-region connection on an Enterprise Edition transit router by calling the UpdateTransitRouterPeerAttachmentAttribute operation.

UpdateTransitRouterRouteEntry.title: Modify the name and description of a route entry in an enterprise edition transit router route table
UpdateTransitRouterRouteEntry.summary: Modifies the name and description of a route entry in an Enterprise Edition transit router route table.

UpdateTransitRouterRouteTable.title: Modify the name and description of an enterprise edition transit router route table
UpdateTransitRouterRouteTable.summary: Calls the UpdateTransitRouterRouteTable operation to modify the name and description of an Enterprise Edition transit router route table and to enable or disable multi-region equal-cost multi-path (ECMP) routing.

UpdateTransitRouterVbrAttachmentAttribut.title: Modify VBR connection on a transit router
UpdateTransitRouterVbrAttachmentAttribut.summary: Modifies the name, description, and automatic route forwarding settings of a virtual border router (VBR) connection on an Enterprise Edition transit router.

UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribut.title: Modify VPC connection information under a transit router
UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribut.summary: Invokes the UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribute operation to modify the name and description of a VPC connection under an Enterprise Edition transit router and specifies whether the Enterprise Edition transit router automatically publishes routing to the VPC-connected instance.

UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones.title: Modify zones and vSwitches associated with a VPC connection
UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones.summary: Modifies the zones and vSwitches associated with a virtual private cloud (VPC) connection by calling the UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones operation.

UpdateTransitRouterVpnAttachmentAttribut.title: Modify VPN connection configurations
UpdateTransitRouterVpnAttachmentAttribut.summary: Invokes the UpdateTransitRouterVpnAttachmentAttribute operation to modify the name, description, and whether to automatically publish route entries for a VPN connection under an Enterprise Edition transit router.

WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries.title: Withdraw route entries published to CEN
WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries.summary: Withdraws routing entries that have been published from a virtual private cloud (VPC) or virtual border router (VBR) instance to Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN).
